blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Modern video games provide a measurable testbed for AI models, combining abilities of visual understanding, instruction decomposition, goal planning, and precise action control over multiple temporal horizons. Existing datasets and benchmarks, however, either cover a narrow range of games, lack language instructions, or rely on high-variance online rollouts. To address these challenges, we introduce GameHorizon, a unified data and evaluation suite that measures gameplay capabilities at different horizons for diverse model families. GameHorizon Suite consists of three components. First, GameHorizon-Annotator is a scalable and automated annotation pipeline for multi-horizon instructions. Second, utilizing the pipeline, we construct GameHorizon-Data, the first large-scale AAA gameplay dataset with temporally aligned videos, player actions, and multi-horizon instructions. It comprises 5 ​ @ ​ 000 5@000 hours of recordings from 21 21 games, collected by 100 100 human expert players. Third, we build GameHorizon-Bench with reproducible offline and stepwise online testing. The offline track enables reproducible evaluation using thousands of standardized questions organized into three primary tasks and a series of diagnostic variants, while the online track tests whether offline scores reflect actual gameplay capabilities and localizes failures to specific steps within long-horizon gameplay. Based on our GameHorizon Suite, we evaluate 47 47 models through more than one million model invocations, revealing a meaningful hierarchy of task difficulty and pronounced differences in model capabilities. Our work can provide a standardized yardstick for evaluating gameplay capabilities across horizons and model families. We will release our dataset, annotator, and benchmark to facilitate future research.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Empowering AI models to play modern video games provides a measurable testbed for understanding, decision-making, and acting within complex environments. Game objectives span varying temporal scales, e.g. , collecting an item within seconds, winning a fight lasting several minutes, and executing a strategy that unfolds over an entire game session, as shown in Fig. 1 . Whatever the horizon, these objectives are all reflected in the same stream of primitive actions, such as keystrokes and mouse movements. Thus, a growing number of dedicated game agents ( Magne et al., 2026 ; Yue et al., 2026 ; Tan et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Cai et al., 2024a ) have emerged. General-purpose vision-language models (VLMs) and agents ( Comanici et al., 2025 ; Team Gemini, 2023 ; Achiam et al., 2023 ; Baker et al., 2022 ; Bolton et al., 2025 ; Qin et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2023 ; Tan et al., 2024 ) have also begun to treat video games as a capability target, e.g. , SIMA 2 ( Bolton et al., 2025 ) equips Gemini ( Comanici et al., 2025 ) to follow instructions in open-world games.
blocks.zh: 赋予AI模型播放现代电子游戏的能力,为理解,决策和在复杂环境中行动提供了一个可衡量的测试床. 游戏目标跨越不同的时间尺度,例如,在秒内收集一个项目,赢得持续数分钟的战斗,以及执行一个贯穿整个游戏会话的战略,如Fig所示. 1 (英语). 无论地平线如何,这些目标都反映在相同的原始行动流中,如按键和鼠标运动. 因此,出现了越来越多的专职游戏代理商(Magne等人,2026年;Yue等人,2026年;Tan等人,2025年;Wang等人,2025年a;Cai等人,2024年a). 通用视觉语言模型(VLMs)和剂(Comanici等人,2025年;Team Gemini等人,2023年;Achiam等人,2023年;Baker等人,2022年;Bolton等人,2025年;Qin等人,2025年;Wang等人,2025年b;Wang等人,2023年;Tan等人,2024年)也开始将电子游戏视为能力目标,例如SIMA 2(Bolton等人,2025年)装备了Gemini(Comanici等人,2025年)在开放世界游戏中遵循指令.

blocks.en: Playing a game well requires two abilities at once: (1) based on an understanding of the situation so far, planning subsequent behavior by decomposing the long-horizon game objective into subgoals; and (2) turning the plans and goals into concrete actions. In practice, these two abilities are split across two families of models. Most dedicated game agents ( Magne et al., 2026 ; Yue et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Cai et al., 2024b ; Cai et al., 2025 ) are optimized for acting rather than planning. To sustain a high control frequency, they adopt lightweight vision-language-action (VLA) or action-head architectures ( Brohan et al., 2023 ; Kim et al., 2024 ) under action-trajectory supervision, at the cost of the capacity to reason and plan. Conversely, general-purpose models ( Comanici et al., 2025 ; Team Gemini, 2023 ; Achiam et al., 2023 ; Anthropic, 2025 ) excel at planning, yet they have never been systematically measured on action. The few reported cases, e.g. , Gemini and Claude playing Pokémon ( Comanici et al., 2025 ; Anthropic, 2025 ) , rely on bespoke agent harnesses and cannot be compared across models. What is needed, therefore, is a single yardstick for both families: one that measures whether a model can align vision, executable actions, and multi-horizon natural-language goals. To be useful, the yardstick should be low-cost, standardized, and reproducible, independent of harnesses or environments.
blocks.zh: 玩游戏需要同时具备两种能力:(1)基于对目前情况的理解,通过将长视游戏目标分解为子目标来规划后续行为;(2)将计划和目标转化为具体行动. 实际上,这两个能力被分成两个模型家族. 大部分专用游戏代理商(Magne等人,2026年;Yue等人,2026年;Li等人,2025年;Cai等人,2024年b;Cai等人,2025年)都优化了行为而非规划. 为了保持高控制频率,它们采用轻量级视觉语言动作(VLA)或动作头像架构(Brohan等人,2023年;Kim等人,2024年),以理性和规划能力为代价,接受动作导电. 相反,通用模型(Comanici等人,2025年;Team Gemini,2023年;Achiam等人,2023年;Anthropic,2025年)在规划方面非常出色,但从未根据行动对其进行系统衡量。 少数报告的案例,例如,双子座和克劳德扮演Pokémon(Comanici等人,2025年;Anthropic,2025年),依靠标语剂,无法在模型中进行比较。 因此,需要为两个家庭制定单一的尺度:一个尺度是衡量一个模型是否能够将愿景、可执行的行动和多角度的自然语言目标结合起来。 为了有用,衡量标准应当是低成本的、标准化的和可复制的,独立于利用或环境。

blocks.en: Existing game datasets and benchmarks fall short of these requirements. First, constrained by annotation cost, their game coverage is narrow. For instance, GameWorld ( Ouyang et al., 2026 ) targets simple mini-games. STEVE-1 ( Lifshitz et al., 2023 ) and MineDojo ( Fan et al., 2022 ) are confined to Minecraft. WildWorld ( Li et al., 2026 ) is collected from a single game, Monster Hunter Wilds. Conclusions drawn from a single title or simplified mini-games cannot generalize to complex and heterogeneous AAA games. Second, human–agent interaction is largely mediated through language, e.g. , instruction following, planning, and goal decomposition. However, previous attempts still lack comprehensive annotations of text instructions and goals. NitroGen ( Magne et al., 2026 ) and GameVerse ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) omit instructions entirely, while Open-P2P ( Yue et al., 2026 ) only provides highly sparse annotations. Consequently, existing data and benchmarks cannot systematically evaluate model performance across instruction following, goal planning, and action execution. Third, prior work mainly relies on online evaluations with a limited number of agent rollouts. Lumine ( Tan et al., 2025 ) reports task success rates only by three trials per scene, while GameVerse ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) conducts rollouts on 3 3 – 20 20 cases. Such small samples lead to low-confidence comparisons. Online results are sensitive to specific game environments and agent harnesses, making them difficult to reproduce. Moreover, an aggregate success rate collapses distinct failure modes into a single scalar. When a model fails, it remains unclear whether it misidentifies current actions, infers the next goal incorrectly, or fails to map the goal to right future controls.
blocks.zh: 现有的游戏数据集和基准没有达到这些要求. 首先,受到注解成本的限制,他们的游戏覆盖范围很窄. 例如,GameWorld(Oyang等人,2026年)针对的是简单的小型游戏. STEVE-1(Lifshitz等人,2023年)和MineDojo(Fan等人,2022年)被限制在Minecraft. WildWorld(Li et al., 2026)是从单游戏"怪兽猎人狂野"中收集的. 从单一标题或简化迷你游戏中得出的结论不能概括为复杂多样的AAA游戏. 第二,人与物剂之间的相互作用主要通过语言进行调解,例如,按照指示、规划和目标分解。 然而,以往的尝试仍然缺乏对案文指示和目标的全面说明。 NitroGen(Magne等人,2026年)和GameVerse(Zhang等人,2026年)完全省略了指令,而Open-P2P(Yue等人,2026年)只提供了极为稀少的说明. 因此,现有数据和基准无法系统地评价整个指令、目标规划和行动执行的示范业绩。 第三,前期工作主要依靠在线评价,代理推出数量有限. Lumine(Tan等人,2025年)报告任务成功率每个场景只进行三次试验,而GameVerse(Zhang等人,2026年)则在3个–20个案件中展开. 如此小的样本导致信心低落的比较. 在线结果对具体的游戏环境和代理工具很敏感,使其难以复制. 此外,总的成功率将不同的失败模式崩溃成单一的平面。 当一个模型失败时,仍然不清楚它是否误认了当前的行为,错误地推断了下一个目标,或者没有将目标映射成正确的未来控制.

blocks.en: To address these challenges, as presented in Fig. 1 , we introduce GameHorizon , a data and evaluation suite spanning multiple temporal horizons and AAA games. It serves as a unified yardstick across a broad range of model types. Specifically, GameHorizon Suite consists of three key components. First, GameHorizon-Annotator is a scalable annotation pipeline for multi-horizon instructions in gameplay. Unlike the manual annotation in Game-TARS ( Wang et al., 2025a ) , GameHorizon-Annotator automatically produces a pyramid of natural-language instructions at three temporal horizons, including short-horizon operations, medium-horizon goals, and long-horizon strategies. The pipeline operates bottom-up, abstracting fine-grained instructions into higher levels. Second, based on the annotator, we construct GameHorizon-Data , a large-scale gameplay dataset with 5 ​ @ ​ 000 5@000 hours of recordings collected from 100 100 human expert players across 21 21 game titles. GameHorizon-Data is the first publicly available dataset that aligns game frames, player actions, and multi-horizon instructions, which also exceeds previous corpora such as D2E ( Choi et al., 2026 ) and gaming-500-hours ( Markov AI, 2026 ) in scale. Third, we build GameHorizon-Bench , combining reproducible offline evaluation and stepwise online testing. The offline track comprises three sorts of primary tasks: single-horizon action, multi-horizon instruction decomposition, and cross-horizon consistency. Additional variants enable model diagnosis at a finer granularity. The offline track is reliable and reproducible based on thousands of questions with standardized actions and instructions. Besides, online track evaluates long-horizon gameplay through short-horizon subtasks, covering order-dependent causal tasks and order-flexible thematic tasks. Environment reset enables stepwise verification and failure localization. This track tests whether offline scores reflect actual gameplay abilities.

blocks.en: We conduct extensive empirical evaluations based on the GameHorizon-Data and GameHorizon-Bench. Our data covers various game categories, e.g. , open-world, action role-playing, competitive shooter, sandbox survival, and creature-collecting adventure genres. Our benchmark involves more than one million model inferences and API calls. For the offline setting, we test 47 47 models on our primary tasks, including general-purpose VLMs ( Comanici et al., 2025 ; Achiam et al., 2023 ; Bai et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) , unified multimodal models (UMMs) ( Diao et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025c ; Tian et al., 2026 ; Deng et al., 2025 ) , coding and GUI agents ( Qin et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; GELab-Team, StepFun, 2025 ; Anthropic, 2026 ) , as well as dedicated game agents ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Yue et al., 2026 ; Magne et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2025 ) . The results reveal a meaningful hierarchy of task difficulty and pronounced differences in model capabilities. For the online setting, we observe a clear positive association between task success rates and offline scores, suggesting that the offline accuracy provides a valid proxy for actual gameplay capabilities. Beyond aggregate performance, we further analyze the bottlenecks of current models. Planning future actions and decomposing complex goals are more challenging than deciding the current action. Compared with the vision-only input, incorporating our medium- and long-horizon instructions improves future-action planning by 7.2 7.2 percentage points, highlighting the effectiveness of our multi-horizon instructions. Our main contributions can be summarized as follows:

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Gameplay Datasets and Benchmarks. Prior gameplay data and benchmarks suffer from narrow game coverage, limited instruction annotations, and high-variance evaluations. First, many datasets are confined to a single game or simplified mini-games. WildWorld ( Li et al., 2026 ) is collected from Monster Hunter Wilds. MineDojo ( Fan et al., 2022 ) , VPT ( Baker et al., 2022 ) , STEVE-1 ( Lifshitz et al., 2023 ) , MineRL ( Guss et al., 2019 ) , and MCU ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) provide data and evaluation exclusively in Minecraft. Some efforts attempt to encompass multiple titles. However, constrained by annotation costs, they either remain limited in scale ( e.g. , 300 hours for D2E by Choi et al., 2026 and 500 hours for gaming-500-hours by Markov AI, 2026 ) or fall back on mini-games ( e.g. , GameWorld by Ouyang et al., 2026 ). Second, existing corpora lack comprehensive text instruction annotations, which are critical for human–agent interaction, e.g. , instruction following and goal planning. NitroGen ( Magne et al., 2026 ) , GameVerse ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) , D2E ( Choi et al., 2026 ) , and VPT ( Baker et al., 2022 ) are entirely devoid of language instructions, whereas Open-P2P ( Yue et al., 2026 ) only offers sparse and coarse annotations. Game-TARS ( Wang et al., 2025a ) relies on costly manual annotations, which hinders scalability and remains unreleased. Third, previous benchmarks mainly adopt online evaluations with a limited number of rollouts. Lumine ( Tan et al., 2025 ) reports success rates by three trials per scene. GameVerse ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) conducts rollouts on 3 3 – 20 20 cases. VideoGameBench ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) likewise tests each model with a single run per game. Such small sample sizes lead to low-confidence comparisons. Online results are sensitive to game environments and custom harnesses, making them difficult to reproduce. In contrast, GameHorizon provides a unified data and evaluation suite, featuring 5 ​ @ ​ 000 5@000 hours of recordings, diverse AAA game genres, multi-horizon instructions, and reproducible offline-online benchmarks.

GameVerse(张等人,2026年)在3 3 – 20 个病例中展开. 视频Game Bench (Zhang等人,2025年)同样以每场比赛的单跑测试每个型号. 如此小的样本尺寸导致信心低的比较. 在线结果对游戏环境和自定义的拉带很敏感,使其难以复制. 相比之下,GameHorizon提供统一的数据和评价套件,其中包含5@000 5@000小时的录音,多样化的AAA游戏流派,多视距指令,以及可复制的离线在线基准.

blocks.en: Game-playing Models. Video games serve as a practical testbed for AI models to perceive, plan, decide, and act in complex environments. Various studies leverage games to enhance or test model capabilities. On one hand, dedicated game agents are typically tailored for high-frequency action control, often at the expense of reasoning abilities, e.g. , long-horizon goal decomposition and planning. Open-P2P ( Yue et al., 2026 ) employs an EfficientNet ( Tan and Le, 2019 ) as a visual encoder alongside a lightweight action decoder for low-latency inference on consumer GPUs, whereas JARVIS-VLA ( Li et al., 2025 ) instantiates a VLA policy with a short context window. On the other hand, general-purpose models, e.g. , VLMs, UMMs, and computer-use agents, exhibit stronger cognitive and planning capabilities, yet they have not been systematically evaluated on action execution. Cradle ( Tan et al., 2024 ) couples GPT-4V ( Achiam et al., 2023 ) with a multi-module agent harness on commercial games. Gemini ( Comanici et al., 2025 ) and Claude ( Anthropic, 2026 ) have been tested on Pokémon through bespoke agent loops. These evaluations remain incomparable due to specialized setups and harnesses. To bridge this gap, GameHorizon presents a unified and standardized yardstick for different models, enabling evaluations across goal planning, instruction following, and executable actions at multiple horizons.
blocks.zh: 游戏游戏模式. 电子游戏作为AI模型在复杂环境中感知,计划,决定和行动的实用测试台. 各种研究利用游戏增强或测试模型能力. 一方面,专用游戏代理通常为高频动作控制而定制,往往牺牲推理能力,如长视目标分解和规划. Open-P2P(Yue等人,2026年)使用一个高效网络(Tan and Le,2019年)作为视觉编码器,同时使用一个轻量级动作解码器对消费者GPU进行低纬度推论,而JARVIS-VLA(Li等人,2025年)则以短上下文窗口即刻发布VLA政策. 另一方面,通用模型,例如VLMs,UMMs,以及计算机使用代理人,显示出更强的认知和规划能力,但是它们还没有对行动执行进行系统的评价. Cradle(Tan et al., 2024)夫妇GPT-4V(Achiam et al., 2023),在商业游戏上拥有多模块的代理机. 双子座(Comanici等人,2025年)和克劳德(Anthropic,2026年)通过点名代理环在Pokémon测试. 这些评价因专门设置和利用而不可比较。 为了弥补这一差距,GameHorizon为不同的模型提供了一个统一和标准化的尺度,使得能够进行贯穿目标规划、跟踪指示和在多个层面可执行的行动的评价。

blocks.en: We present GameHorizon, a unified data and evaluation suite spanning multiple temporal horizons, diverse AAA games, and a broad range of model families. We outline our approach in Sec. 3.1 . In Sec. 3.2 , we elaborate on GameHorizon-Annotator, an automated and scalable annotation pipeline for multi-horizon instructions. Our large-scale GameHorizon-Data is discussed in Sec. 3.3 , while GameHorizon-Bench is illustrated in Sec. 3.4 .
blocks.zh: 我们介绍GameHorizon, 一个跨越多个时间范围的统一的数据和评价套件, 不同的AAA游戏, 和广泛的模范家庭。 我们概述了我们在塞克的做法。 3.1. 在3.2节中,我们详细阐述了GameHorizon-An Notator,这是一个用于多视距指示的自动化和可伸缩的注解管道。 我们的大规模GameHorizon-Data在3.3 Sec中讨论,而GameHorizon-Bench则在Sec中说明. 3.4 (英语).

blocks.zh: 3.1 概览

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 2 , GameHorizon Suite comprises three components: GameHorizon-Annotator, GameHorizon-Data, and GameHorizon-Bench. The workflow begins with raw gameplay acquisition. Previous work collects web videos and recovers action pseudo-labels via Inverse Dynamics Models (IDMs) ( Baker et al., 2022 ; Lifshitz et al., 2023 ; Choi et al., 2026 ) or gamepad segmentation ( Magne et al., 2026 ; Xie et al., 2021 ) . The inferred pseudo-labels can deviate from the actual controls executed by humans. In contrast, we recruit 100 100 experienced human players and deploy a dedicated recording-and-upload system to synchronously capture game videos at 2K resolution along with timestamped keyboard and mouse actions. Authentic human gameplay recordings and action trajectories can establish a reliable foundation for faithful evaluations in complex game worlds.
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,GameHorizon Suite由三部分组成:GameHorizon-Annotator,GameHorizon-Data,以及GameHorizon-Bench. 工作流程从原始游戏游戏获取开始. 之前的作品通过逆动态模型(IDMs)收集网络视频并回收动作伪标签(Baker等人,2022年;Lifshitz等人,2023年;Choi等人,2026年)或游戏板分割(Magne等人,2026年;Xie等人,2021年). 推断出的假标签可以偏离人类实际执行的控制. 相比之下,我们招募了100名有经验的人类玩家,并部署了专门的录制和上载系统,以2K分辨率同步捕获游戏视频,同时进行时间戳键盘和鼠标动作. 真实的人类游戏游戏录音和动作轨迹可以为复杂的游戏世界中的忠实评价建立可靠的基础.

blocks.en:
Based on the recordings, we develop GameHorizon-Annotator, an annotation pipeline for textual instructions across multiple temporal horizons. Due to annotation costs or vision-only architectures,
prior studies either omit instructions ( Magne et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) or provide sparse labels ( Yue et al., 2026 ) . Game-TARS ( Wang et al., 2025a ) relies on manual instruction labeling, which is expensive and remains unavailable to the community. However, instructions are vital for human-agent interaction, e.g. , instruction following and goal decomposition. When issuing requests to an agent, humans dictate not only primitive actions like reloading a weapon, but also long-term objectives such as defending a bridge. To this end, our GameHorizon-Annotator produces a three-level pyramid of instructions, including short-horizon operations ( 1 1 – 5 5 seconds), medium-horizon goals ( 1 1 – 2 2 minutes), and long-horizon strategies ( 5 5 – 8 8 minutes). The annotator operates bottom-up, abstracting dense and action-grounded instructions into higher-level goals and strategies. The automated pipeline reduces annotation costs and enables scalable labeling across large gameplay collections.

blocks.en: Applying GameHorizon-Annotator to the collected trajectories, we construct GameHorizon-Data, the first large-scale AAA gameplay dataset that aligns videos, player actions, and multi-horizon instructions. It covers 5 ​ @ ​ 000 5@000 hours of human gameplay from 21 21 game titles, spanning diverse genres such as open-world, action role-playing, competitive shooter, sandbox survival, and creature-collecting adventure titles. In total, GameHorizon-Data contains 4 ​ @ ​ 571 4@571 videos recorded at 60 60 fps and 411.03 411.03 million keyboard-mouse action events. It is annotated with 6 ​ @ ​ 184 ​ @ ​ 036 6@184@036 distinct instructions, including 5 ​ @ ​ 947 ​ @ ​ 588 5@947@588 short-horizon operations, 189 ​ @ ​ 158 189@158 medium-horizon goals, and 47 ​ @ ​ 290 47@290 long-horizon strategies. On average, GameHorizon-Data provides one distinct short-horizon instruction every 2.63 2.63 seconds, while each frame is aligned with corresponding instructions at all three horizons. Our annotations are substantially denser than those in prior work. For example, Open-P2P ( Yue et al., 2026 ) includes only one instruction every few minutes, with uneven temporal coverage. Combining scale, density, and diversity, GameHorizon-Data enables unified evaluations of multi-horizon gameplay tasks and capabilities.
blocks.zh: 将GameHorizon-Annotator应用到收集的轨迹中,我们构建了GameHorizon-Data,这是第一个大规模AAA游戏机数据集,可以对视频,玩家动作,以及多视距指令进行校正. 它涵盖了来自21个21个游戏标题的5@000 5@000小时的人类游戏,涵盖开放世界,动作角色扮演,竞技射手,沙盒生存,以及生物采集冒险标题等多种流派. GameHorizon-Data总共收录了4@571 4@571视频,收录了60 fps和411.03 411.03万个键盘-mouse动作事件. 附加说明的有6@184@036@184@036明确指示,包括5@947@588 5@947@588短视业务,189@158189@158中视目标,47@29047@290长视战略。 平均来说,GameHorizon-Data每2.632.63秒提供一次独特的短视指令,而每个帧在所有三个视野都与相应的指令一致. 我们的说明比以前的工作要密集得多。 例如,开放-P2P (Yue等人,2026年)每几分钟只包含一次指令,时间覆盖范围不均匀. GameHorizon-Data将规模、密度和多样性结合起来,可以对多视距游戏游戏任务和能力进行统一评价。

blocks.en: Finally, leveraging GameHorizon-Data, we introduce GameHorizon-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark featuring reproducible offline and stepwise online testing across diverse model families. As discussed in Sec. 1 , prior gameplay benchmarks predominantly rely on a small number of harness-dependent online rollouts ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Tan et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) , yielding low-confidence comparisons that are difficult to reproduce. Aggregate success rates also conflate different failure modes. In contrast, the offline track of our GameHorizon-Bench ensures reliable and reproducible evaluation through thousands of multiple-choice questions (MCQs) with standardized actions and instructions in three primary tasks, including single-horizon action, multi-horizon instruction decomposition, and cross-horizon consistency. Additional diagnostic variants further probe model capabilities along different dimensions, e.g. , current-action perception vs. future-action planning and top-down decomposition vs. bottom-up abstraction. Complementarily, the online track evaluates long-horizon gameplay through collections of verifiable short-horizon subtasks. It covers causal tasks, whose subtasks follow a prescribed sequence, and thematic tasks, whose subtasks can be completed in any order. When an agent fails at a subtask, the environment is reset to the corresponding success state, allowing evaluation to continue. The stepwise protocol localizes errors to specific steps. Our online track further tests whether offline scores reflect actual gameplay abilities. Together, the two tracks establish GameHorizon-Bench as a unified, standardized, reproducible, and diagnostic yardstick across model families and temporal horizons.
blocks.zh: 最后,利用GameHorizon-Data, 我们引入了GameHorizon-Bench, 一个全面的基准, 以可复制的离线测试和跨不同模范家庭的逐步在线测试为主。 如Sec.1所述,之前的游戏玩法基准主要依靠少量依赖驾驭的在线推出(Zhang et al.,2025;Tan et al.,2025;Zhang et al.,2026),产生了难以复制的低信心比较. 综合成功率也混合了不同的失败模式. 相比之下,我们的GameHorizon-Bench的离线轨道通过数千个多选择问题确保可靠和可复制的评价,在三项主要任务中采取标准化行动和指示,包括单视行动、多视距指令解析和跨视距一致性。 附加的诊断变体进一步沿不同维度探测模型能力,如:当前动作感知与未来动作规划和自上而下分解与自下而上抽象. 作为补充,在线赛道通过可核查的短视子任务的收集来评价长视游戏. 它包括因果任务,其子任务遵循规定的顺序,以及主题任务,其子任务可以按任何顺序完成. 当代理在子任务中失败时,环境被重置到相应的成功状态,使得评价得以继续. 渐进协议将错误定位到特定步骤。 我们的在线赛道进一步测试下线分数是否反映了实际的游戏游戏能力. 两条轨道共同将GameHorizon-Bench确定为跨越模范家庭和时间范围的统一、标准化、可复制和诊断的尺度。

blocks.en: 3.2 GameHorizon-Annotator
blocks.zh: 3.2 GameHorizon-注释器

blocks.en: Given synchronized videos and actions, GameHorizon-Annotator constructs a three-level instruction pyramid, i.e. , short-horizon operations, medium-horizon goals, and long-horizon strategies. As illustrated in Fig. 3 , our workflow comprises the action-aware segmentation, bottom-up temporal merging, and instruction annotation.
blocks.zh: 由于视频和行动同步,GameHorizon-Annotator构建了三级教学金字塔,即短视操作,中视目标,长视战略. 如图3所示,我们的工作流程包括行动意识分割、自下而上的时间合并和指示注释。

blocks.en: Action-Aware Video Segmentation. Constructing multi-horizon instructions from videos in a top-down manner is challenging, as VLMs struggle to resolve fine-grained visual and action details across extended temporal contexts, e.g. , an hour-long gameplay session. We therefore proceed bottom-up, partitioning long videos into short clips that VLMs can interpret more reliably. However, off-the-shelf segmentation tools such as PySceneDetect ( Castellano, 2024 ) rely on frame-to-frame visual similarity and tend to over-segment continuous actions, e.g. , under rapid camera motion or abrupt viewpoint shifts. To address this issue, we perform action-aware segmentation using keyboard-mouse traces to identify key action transitions and determine clip boundaries. Specifically, we map raw keyboard-mouse events to game-specific action semantics, e.g. , Shift as sprinting in Cyberpunk 2077. We then scan the mapped action stream chronologically, grouping consecutive actions within the same sustained event, such as alternating between walking and running during a single traversal. Discrete action events such as jumping or attacking define initial boundaries for coarse segmentation. Since the same keyboard-mouse input may carry different action semantics, e.g. , a left click may indicate an attack or item selection, we employ a VLM ( Google DeepMind, 2026a ) to examine video frames, disambiguate action semantics, and refine the initial segmentation to a final set of short-horizon clips.
blocks.zh: Action-Award视频分区. 从视频中以自上而下的方式构建多视距指令具有挑战性,因为VLMs在较长的时间背景中努力解决精细的视觉和行动细节,例如一个小时的游戏会话. 因此,我们从下往上,将长视频分成短片,VLM可以更可靠地解释。 然而,PyScene Detection(Castellano,2024年)等现成的分解工具依赖于帧对帧的视觉相似性,并倾向于过度分解的连续动作,例如在快速相机运动或突如其来的视线转移下. 为了解决这一问题,我们利用键盘-mouse痕迹进行动作感知分解,以识别关键动作过渡并确定剪辑边界. 具体来说,我们将原始键盘-mouse事件映射到游戏特定动作语义,例如Shift作为冲刺在Cyberpunk 2077中. 然后,我们按时间顺序扫描所绘制的动作流, 在同一持续事件中将连续的动作分组, 例如在一次穿行中走动和跑动之间的交替。 跳跃或攻击等任意动作事件定义了粗细分割的初始边界. 由于相同的键盘-mouse输入可能携带不同的动作语义,例如,左键点击可能表示攻击或项目选择,因此我们使用VLM(Google DeepMind,2026a)来检查视频帧,将动作语义解析,并将初始分解精细化为最后一组短视片段.

blocks.en: Bottom-Up Temporal Merging. Based on the short-horizon ( L 1 L_{1} ) clips and instructions, we merge adjacent segments into medium-horizon ( L 2 L_{2} ) clips. Specifically, the VLM ( Google DeepMind, 2026a ) determines whether neighboring L 1 L_{1} operations form a continuous progression toward the same medium-horizon goal. Similarly, to construct long-horizon ( L 3 L_{3} ) clips, the VLM assesses whether neighboring L 2 L_{2} goals follow the same gameplay strategy. Besides, we apply a dynamic programming algorithm ( Bellman, 1966 ) to enforce level-specific duration ranges of 1 1 – 5 5 seconds for L 1 L_{1} , 1 1 – 2 2 minutes for L 2 L_{2} , and 5 5 – 8 8 minutes for L 3 L_{3} . The short range helps avoid fragmenting primitive actions, while the long range keeps clip durations within the reasoning capacity of current models. We term the temporal merging process bottom-up because it starts from numerous fine-grained L 1 L_{1} clips at the base of the pyramid and progressively merges them into fewer higher-level clips.
blocks.zh: 从下到上的时间合并。 根据短视(L1 L_{1})的片段和指示,我们把相邻的片段合并为中视(L2 L_{2})片段. VLM(Google DeepMind, 2026a)决定邻接的L1LQX1}业务是否形成向同一中等视距目标的持续发展。 同样,为了构建长视线(L 3 L_{3})片段,VLM评估邻近的L 2 L_{2}目标是否遵循相同的游戏策略. 此外,我们运用动态编程算法(Bellman,1966年)强制实施级别特定持续时间范围为:L1 LQQ1}1 1 - 5 5秒;L2 LQX2}1 1 - 2分钟;L3 LQX3}5 5 - 8分钟。 短距离有助于避免原始动作的分裂,而长距离则将剪辑持续时间保持在当前模型的推理能力范围内. 我们自下而上地定义了时间合并过程,因为它是从金字塔底部的众多精细L1L_{1}的剪辑开始的,并逐渐将其合并为较少的更高层次的剪辑.

blocks.en: Multi-Horizon Instruction Annotation. The VLM ( Google DeepMind, 2026a ) produces instructions at each level using specific prompts with distinct input modalities and output granularities. For an L 1 L_{1} clip, the VLM receives sampled video frames and temporally aligned keyboard-mouse actions as input. The prompt asks the VLM to generate an action-grounded instruction describing the current operation of the player. We also require the VLM to include sufficient details, such as coordinates, object descriptions, and spatial relations, when needed to guide a virtual agent in game sessions. For an L 2 L_{2} clip, frames, actions, and the constituent L 1 L_{1} instructions serve as inputs to the VLM. The VLM synthesizes these inputs into a medium-horizon instruction describing the goal pursued by the player. We require the output to retain only necessary details while avoiding excessive local information. For an L 3 L_{3} clip, the inputs comprise video frames and the constituent L 2 L_{2} instructions, without action traces. The VLM generates a long-horizon instruction that captures the high-level gameplay strategy. The prompt emphasizes the long-term intent while suppressing local operational details.
blocks.zh: 多视野指示注释. VLM (Google DeepMind, 2026a) 使用带有不同输入模式和输出颗粒的具体提示来制作每个级别的指令. 对于一个L 1 LQQ1} 的剪辑, VLM 接收到样本的视频帧和时间对齐的键盘- mouse 动作作为输入. 提示要求 VLM 生成一个基于动作的指令,描述玩家当前的操作. 我们还要求VLM在需要时包含足够的细节,如坐标,对象描述和空间关系,以指导虚拟代理在游戏会话中. 对于L2 L_{2}的剪辑,帧,动作,以及组成L1 L_{1}的指令,作为VLM的输入. blocks.en: For L 1 L_{1} and L 2 L_{2} , the action inputs to the VLM ground the instructions in controls executed by players rather than visual evidence alone. The actions are useful for identifying visually ambiguous operations, e.g. , determining whether the player detaches from the squad during skydiving in Apex Legends. By comparison, we omit actions at L 3 L_{3} to keep the instructions focused on high-level strategies rather than detailed operations.
blocks.zh: 对于L 1 L_{1}和L 2 L_{2},对 VLM 的动作输入将指令建立在玩家执行的控制中,而不是光是视觉证据. 动作有助于识别视觉模糊的操作,例如,确定玩家在Apex Legends中跳伞时是否偏离了队伍. 相比之下,我们省略了在L 3 L_{3}中的行动,以使指示侧重于高级别战略,而不是详细的操作。

blocks.en: All prompts include the game title, clip duration, frame rate, and sampled frame indices for reference. At higher levels, the constituent lower-level instructions provide compact semantic context and help maintain consistency across horizons. The L 1 L_{1} and L 2 L_{2} prompts also incorporate game-specific keybinds that map keyboard-mouse actions to corresponding in-game semantics, facilitating action interpretation by the VLM.
blocks.zh: 所有提示包括游戏标题,剪辑持续时间,帧率,以及抽样的帧指数以供参考. 在更高层次上,构成的低级指令提供了紧凑的语义上下文,并有助于保持全域的一致性. L1 L_{1}和L2 L_{2}的提示符也包含了游戏特定的键盘,将键盘-mouse动作映射到相应的游戏中语义,方便了VLM的动作解释.

blocks.en: Overall Workflow. As illustrated in Fig. 3 , action-aware segmentation first partitions a recording of a complete gameplay session into L 1 L_{1} clips, each annotated with a short-horizon operation. Using the L 1 L_{1} instructions as semantic cues, we merge adjacent L 1 L_{1} clips into L 2 L_{2} clips and annotate them with medium-horizon goals. We then merge L 2 L_{2} clips into L 3 L_{3} clips and annotate them with long-horizon strategies. The GameHorizon-Annotator proceeds bottom-up via alternating temporal merging and instruction annotation across all temporal horizons. See the appendix for additional details regarding our prompt design, segmentation, instructions, and keybinds.

blocks.zh: 3.3 GameHorizon-数据

blocks.en: Using our annotator, we construct GameHorizon-Data as a large-scale corpus with gameplay videos, actions, and multi-horizon instructions across diverse games. We report data statistics and comparisons in this section.
blocks.zh: 使用我们的注释器,我们构建了GameHorizon-Data作为一个大型的游戏机,包含游戏游戏视频,动作,以及跨不同游戏的多视距指令. 我们在本节中报告数据统计和比较。

blocks.en: Dataset Statistics. We present detailed statistics of our GameHorizon-Data in Table 1 . First, regarding data scale and proportion, the corpus comprises 5 ​ @ ​ 000 5@000 hours of human gameplay across 21 21 game titles, spanning diverse genres such as open-world, action role-playing, competitive shooter, sandbox survival, and creature-collecting adventure games. Valorant contributes the largest share with 617.5 617.5 hours ( 12.35 % 12.35\% ), while even the smallest entry, Honor of Kings: World, contains 35.9 35.9 hours ( 0.72 % 0.72\% ). All recordings are collected from 100 100 experienced players who receive extensive training on the recording and upload procedures. We filter out low-quality or uninformative content using automated rules and VLM assessments, e.g. , prolonged action-free cutscenes and switches away from the game window. After filtering, 4 ​ @ ​ 341 4@341 hours ( 86.8 % 86.8\% ) are retained for instruction annotation, while the synchronized keyboard-mouse actions remain available for all 5 ​ @ ​ 000 5@000 hours. Second, in terms of annotation counts, GameHorizon-Data contains 411.03 411.03 million keyboard-mouse action events, averaging 22.84 22.84 events per second. The action stream combines mouse inputs (movements and button presses) sampled at 20 20 Hz with an average of 2.84 2.84 keyboard events per second. The retained footage is annotated with 6 ​ @ ​ 184 ​ @ ​ 036 6@184@036 textual instructions, including 5 ​ @ ​ 947 ​ @ ​ 588 5@947@588 short-horizon operations, 189 ​ @ ​ 158 189@158 medium-horizon goals, and 47 ​ @ ​ 290 47@290 long-horizon strategies. Third, turning to instruction spans, the average duration increases across horizons, i.e. , 2.63 2.63 seconds for L 1 L_{1} , 82.6 82.6 seconds for L 2 L_{2} , and 330.4 330.4 seconds for L 3 L_{3} . Each span measures the temporal coverage of one distinct instruction, with all frames in the corresponding clip sharing the same instruction at that horizon. Thus, every frame is simultaneously aligned with instructions at all three horizons, yielding our dense multi-horizon instruction pyramid across diverse AAA gameplay scenarios.

blocks.en: 3.4 GameHorizon-Bench
blocks.zh: 3.4 GameHorizon-奔驰

blocks.en: Leveraging our data, we develop GameHorizon-Bench, a unified benchmark that evaluates multi-horizon gameplay capabilities across diverse model families through the reproducible offline and stepwise online tracks.
blocks.zh: 利用我们的数据,我们开发了GameHorizon-Bench这个统一的基准,通过可复制的离线和继发的在线音轨,评价不同模式家庭的多视距游戏能力.

blocks.en: Reproducible Offline Track. The offline track formulates gameplay evaluation as standardized MCQs derived from the aligned frames, multi-horizon instructions, and player actions in GameHorizon-Data. It contains thousands of questions organized into three primary tasks and ten variant tasks. High-quality annotations, standardized inputs and options, as well as independence from game environments and agent harnesses enable unified and reproducible comparisons across the VLMs, UMMs, GUI agents, coding agents, and game agents.
blocks.zh: 可复制离线轨道. 离线轨道将游戏游戏评价设定为标准化的MCQ,衍生自对齐的帧,多视距指令,以及GameHorizon-Data中的玩家动作. 它包含数以千计的问题,分为三大任务和十个变种任务. 高质量的说明,标准化的输入和选项,以及独立于游戏环境和代理工具,使得VLMs,UMMs,GUI代理,编码代理,以及游戏代理能够进行统一和可复制的比较.

blocks.en: To be specific, as shown in Fig. 4 , the single-horizon action task ( T 1 T_{1} ) asks models to make the correct action decision based on input frames and the short-horizon instruction ( L 1 L_{1} ). The correct option is constructed by mapping ground-truth keyboard-mouse controls to textual action sequences using game-specific keybinds, which enables unified evaluation across games and models without being constrained by heterogeneous action spaces. T 1 T_{1} provides a rigorous test centered on action perception. Next, the multi-horizon decomposition task ( T 2 T_{2} ) requires models to identify the ordered sequence of short-horizon operations for realizing a medium-horizon goal ( L 2 L_{2} ). The correct option presents the L 1 L_{1} sequence corresponding to the target L 2 L_{2} goal within the pyramid, whereas the distractors differ in their composition and temporal order. T 2 T_{2} evaluates top-down goal decomposition and temporal planning from abstract goals to concrete operations. Finally, the cross-horizon consistency task ( T 3 T_{3} ) assesses the overall consistency across videos, instructions, and actions. The correct option consists of the aligned L 3 L_{3} , L 2 L_{2} , and L 1 L_{1} instructions, along with the action sequence from the pyramid. T 3 T_{3} focuses on integrated understanding across visual observations, textual instructions, and gameplay actions.
blocks.zh: 具体而言,如图4所示,单视线行动任务(T 1 T_{1})要求模型根据输入框架和短视指令(L 1 L_{1})做出正确的行动决定. 正确的选项是通过将地面-真实键盘-mouse控制映射到文字动作序列来构建的,使用游戏特定键盘,可以实现跨游戏和模型的统一评价,而不受不同动作空间的限制. T1 TQQQ1}提供了一个以动作感知为中心的严格测试. 接下来,多视距分解任务(T2 T_{2})需要模型来识别实现中视距目标(L2 L_{2})的有序短视操作序列. 正确的选项在金字塔内呈现与目标L 2 L_{2}目标相对应的L 1 L_{1}的序列,而分心者在组成和时间顺序上有所不同. T2 T_{2}评价自上而下的目标分解和时间规划,从抽象的目标到具体的行动. 最后,跨视野一致性任务(T 3 T_{3})评估了视频、指示和行动的整体一致性。 正确的选项包括对齐的L 3 L_{3},L 2 L_{2}和L 1 L_{1}指令,以及来自金字塔的动作序列. T 3 TQQQ3} 专注于跨视觉观察,文本指令,游戏游戏动作的综合理解.

blocks.en: Moreover, a series of variant tasks ( T ∗ T^{*} ) can provide additional diagnostics and analyses of different gameplay capabilities. For T 1 ∗ T_{1}^{*} , we compare current-action perception and future-action planning under three input settings, including frames only, frames with a short-horizon instruction, and frames with multi-horizon instructions. The comparison reveals how textual instructions influence action decisions and planning. For T 2 ∗ T_{2}^{*} , we compare top-down decomposition from L 2 L_{2} goals to L 1 L_{1} operations with bottom-up abstraction in the reverse direction. The comparison clarifies the rationale for our bottom-up annotation pipeline and top-down benchmark design. As for T 3 ∗ T_{3}^{*} , we compare instruction-only versus instruction-and-action options. The comparison helps identify whether the performance bottlenecks arise from goal planning or action decoding.
blocks.zh: 此外,一系列的变体任务(T ∗ T^{*})可以对不同的游戏游戏能力提供额外的诊断和分析. 对于T 1 * T_{1}^{*},我们将当前动作感知与未来动作规划在三个输入设置下进行比较,其中仅包括帧,帧与短视指令,帧与多视距指令. 这一比较揭示了文字指示如何影响行动决定和规划。 对于T 2 * T_{2}^{*},我们用反方向的自下而上的抽象来比较L 2 L_{2}目标与L 1 L_{1)的操作. 比较澄清了我们自下而上的注解管道和自上而下的基准设计的理由。 至于T 3 * T 3 + + + 3 + ,我们比较了仅指令与指令与行动选项. 比较有助于确定业绩瓶颈是来自目标规划还是行动解码。

blocks.en: Figure 5: The online track of GameHorizon-Bench. It contains long-horizon causal and thematic tasks, each comprising multiple verifiable short-horizon subtasks. The causal tasks can only be completed in a prescribed order because of dependencies between successive subtasks. The thematic tasks contain subtasks that share a common theme but can be performed in any order. The figure shows results from Gemini 3.6 Flash ( Google DeepMind, 2026b ) , with arrows indicating its actual execution order. After a subtask fails, the environment is reset to the corresponding success state so that evaluation can continue. A long-horizon task is considered passed only when all constituent subtasks succeed.

blocks.en: Stepwise Online Track. As a complementary evaluation, our online track tests whether offline scores are positively associated with gameplay capabilities. It evaluates long-horizon gameplay through order-dependent causal tasks and order-flexible thematic tasks, each comprising 2 2 – 6 6 verifiable short-horizon subtasks. When a subtask fails, the game is reset to the corresponding success state to prevent the failure from affecting subsequent steps. Beyond the aggregate success rates in previous work ( Tan et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Bolton et al., 2025 ) , our stepwise protocol can localize failures to specific stages within long-horizon objectives.
blocks.zh: 步步在线音轨. 作为补充评价,我们的在线轨道测试离线得分是否与游戏游戏能力有正面关联. 它通过命令依赖的因果任务和命令灵活的主题任务来评价长视线游戏,每个任务包含2个2 – 6个可核查的短视子任务. 当子任务失败时,游戏会被重置到相应的成功状态,以防止失败影响后续步骤. 除了前期工作的总成功率(Tan等人,2025年;Wang等人,2025年a;Bolton等人,2025年)之外,我们的逐步协议可以将失败定位到长期目标的具体阶段。

blocks.en: Specifically, the online track comprises 10 10 causal and 10 10 thematic tasks with 62 62 short-horizon subtasks. Due to the inaccessibility of underlying game states in most AAA titles, we implement the online track in Minecraft, as in prior work ( Ju et al., 2026 ; Zheng et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Cai et al., 2024a ; Fan et al., 2022 ) . Four example tasks are presented in Fig. 5 with the actual execution order and results of Gemini 3.6 Flash ( Google DeepMind, 2026b ) . The steps within each causal task have sequential dependencies, e.g., first collecting milk, then crafting a cake, and finally placing it on the dining table. For thematic tasks, the subtasks share a common theme and can be completed in any order, e.g., crafting a wooden pickaxe, axe, and shovel for a toolkit. In the failure cases, Gemini 3.6 Flash understands intended operations yet still commits execution errors, e.g. , placing objects in inaccurate positions or failing to follow the correct recipe when making a cake.

blocks.en: We conduct extensive experiments and systematic evaluations using our GameHorizon-Bench. We describe the evaluation protocols and implementation details in Sec. 4.1 . The testing results on our offline primary tasks and variant tasks are presented in Sec. 4.2 and Sec. 4.3 , respectively. Besides, Sec. 4.4 reports the results from our stepwise online track, which examines the relations between offline scores and online gameplay abilities.

blocks.en: 4.1 Evaluation Protocols and Details
blocks.zh: 4.1 评价协议和细节

blocks.en: Offline Track. We evaluate 47 47 models spanning five categories, including 35 35 general-purpose VLMs, 4 4 UMMs, 2 2 GUI agents, 3 3 coding agents, and 3 3 dedicated game agents. The 44 44 models of the first four types natively support question answering. We adopt unified MCQs for all offline tasks. Each model receives the same four-option questions and directly outputs the selections, ensuring standardized and reproducible evaluation.
blocks.zh: 离线轨道。 我们评价47种47种模式,包括35种通用VLM,4种UMM,2种GUI代理,3种编码代理,3种专用游戏代理. 前四类的44个44个型号在本土支持问答. 我们对所有离线任务采用统一的MCQ. 每个模式都收到相同的四个选项问题,直接输出选择,确保标准化和可复制的评价。

blocks.en: On the other hand, the dedicated game agents ( Yue et al., 2026 ; Magne et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2025 ) are trained to produce action sequences without supporting question answering or reasoning. Thus, we evaluate these models only on the single-horizon action task ( T 1 T_{1} ) by matching their action predictions against the four options via sequence alignment ( Needleman and Wunsch, 1970 ) . The option with the highest alignment score is taken as the selected answer. If all four scores fall below a threshold, indicating no meaningful overlap with any option, the prediction is marked incorrect, e.g. , an empty action sequence. For NitroGen ( Magne et al., 2026 ) , we additionally map its gamepad actions to the keyboard-and-mouse trajectories using our keybinds.
blocks.zh: 另一方面,专门的游戏代理商(Yue等人,2026年;Magne等人,2026年;Li等人,2025年)在不支持提问回答或推理的情况下接受制作动作序列的培训. 因此,我们只根据单视行动任务(T 1 T_{1})来评估这些模型,办法是通过顺序对齐(Needleman and Wunsch, 1970年),将其动作预测与四个选项相匹配。 对齐分数最高的选项作为选定的答案。 如果所有四个分数都跌到一个阈值以下,表明与任何选项没有有意义的重叠,那么预测就被标记错了,如空动作序列. 对于NitroGen(Magne等人, 2026年),我们额外将其游戏板动作映射到键盘-和-mouse的轨迹上,使用我们的键盘.

blocks.en: As for the implementation details, each of the three primary tasks ( T 1 T_{1} – T 3 T_{3} ) contains 1 ​ @ ​ 000 1@000 MCQs, while each of the ten variants contains 200 200 MCQs. In total, the offline track consists of 5 ​ @ ​ 000 5@000 MCQs for high-confidence and reliable evaluation. Some models are evaluated through their official APIs, while the others are served locally on GPUs. The inference of dedicated game agents follows their official checkpoints, rollout procedures, and context-window sizes, whereas the other four model categories are given the same number of input frames. We report MCQ accuracy for all models and divide them into four performance tiers based on their rankings.
blocks.zh: 至于执行细节,三大任务(T1 T_{1} – T3 T_{3})中每个任务包含1@000 1@000 MCQ,而十个变体中每个任务包含200 200 MCQ. 离线轨道总共包括5@000 5@000 MCQ,用于高自信和可靠的评价. 有些模型通过官方API来评价,而其他模型则在GPU上在当地服务. 专用游戏代理商的推论遵循其官方检查站,推出程序和上下文窗口大小,而其他四个模式类别获得的输入帧数量相同. 我们报告所有模型的MCQ精度,并根据它们的排名将其分为四个性能等级.

blocks.en: Online Track. Due to evaluation costs, we sample three models per offline tier, yielding 12 12 models for online testing. We construct ten causal and ten thematic tasks with 62 62 short-horizon subtasks. The thematic tasks span diverse themes, e.g. , resource gathering, crafting, farming, building, and combat. A multi-step long-horizon task is considered passed only when the model completes it end-to-end without intermediate failures and game resets. Besides, each subtask is allocated a maximum budget of 400 400 model calls. Any subtask not completed within this budget is marked as failed. The task outcomes are automatically determined by the underlying game states. We report success rates for both short-horizon subtasks and long-horizon tasks.
blocks.zh: 在线轨道. 由于评估成本,我们抽取了每一级离线的三个模型,产生了12个在线测试模型。 我们设计了10项因果任务和10项专题任务,并配有62项短期任务。 专题任务涉及各种主题,如资源收集、手工艺、耕作、建筑和战斗。 一种多步长视距任务只有在模型完成时才被认为通过,没有中间故障和游戏重置. 此外,每个子任务被分配最多400400个型号呼叫的预算. 在本预算范围内未完成的任何子任务都标记为失败 。 任务结果由基础游戏状态自动决定. 我们报告短期和长期任务的成功率。

blocks.en: Benchmark Discriminability. We first test the 44 44 models with question-answering abilities in Table 4 . The mean accuracy across our benchmark is 64.7 % 64.7\% , substantially above the 25 % 25\% random baseline, suggesting that the designed tasks are solvable yet challenging for meaningful evaluation. Among the evaluated models, the accuracy ranges from 44.6 % 44.6\% to 80.2 % 80.2\% , spanning 35.6 35.6 percentage points and clearly distinguishing models in different capability tiers. At the task level, the results reveal a coherent difficulty hierarchy, i.e. , 57.3 % 57.3\% on T 1 T_{1} , 65.1 % 65.1\% on T 2 T_{2} , and 71.6 % 71.6\% on T 3 T_{3} . T 1 T_{1} is the most difficult task because it requires fine-grained action prediction under strict correctness criteria from keyboard-mouse trajectories. T 3 T_{3} emphasizes cross-horizon understanding and exhibits the highest accuracy because the options provide rich information from multi-horizon instructions and actions. T 2 T_{2} lies between T 1 T_{1} and T 3 T_{3} , focusing on the decomposition and planning of complex goals. Overall, our GameHorizon-Bench demonstrates an appropriate task-difficulty gradient and clear model discriminability.

blocks.en: General-Purpose VLMs. Proprietary models dominate the top of the leaderboard, occupying ten of the eleven positions in Tier 1. GPT-6-Astra ranks first with 80.2 % 80.2\% overall accuracy, followed by Gemini 3.8 Flash and Gemini 3.7 Flash with 77.3 % 77.3\% and 76.7 % 76.7\% , respectively. Kimi-K3 is the only open-weight model in Tier 1, ranking sixth with 74.5 % 74.5\% . Recent open-weight models also show competitive performance, e.g. , Qwen3.8-27B, Kimi-K2.6, and Gemma 4 31B-IT rank 16th, 17th, and 20th, surpassing several proprietary models. Within the same model family, newer or larger variants generally perform better. For example, overall accuracy increases from 62.8 % 62.8\% for GPT-5.2 to 73.2 % 73.2\% for GPT-5.5, 74.8 % 74.8\% for GPT-5.6 Sol, and 80.2 % 80.2\% for GPT-6-Astra. Similar trends are also observed in other families, such as Gemini, Kimi, Qwen, Doubao, InternVL, and GLM.

blocks.en: Unified Multimodal Models. We evaluate four UMMs, including BAGEL-7B-MoT ( Deng et al., 2025 ) , SenseNova-U1-8B-MoT ( Diao et al., 2026 ) , Ovis-U1-3B ( Wang et al., 2025c ) , and InternVL-U-4B ( Tian et al., 2026 ) . All four models fall into Tier 3 or Tier 4, indicating that current UMMs remain less competitive in gameplay tasks. The larger models perform better, i.e. , BAGEL-7B-MoT achieves 61.4 % 61.4\% and ranks 30th, while SenseNova-U1-8B-MoT achieves 58.3 % 58.3\% and ranks 33rd. In comparison, Ovis-U1-3B and InternVL-U-4B achieve only 47.8 % 47.8\% and 44.6 % 44.6\% . To examine potential interference between understanding and generation, we compare InternVL-U-4B with its understanding backbone, InternVL3.5-2B. Despite having additional generation parameters, InternVL-U-4B underperforms InternVL3.5-2B by 1.4 1.4 percentage points. The result suggests that unifying understanding and generation could introduce interference, offsetting gains from increased capacity.

blocks.en: GUI Agents. We evaluate two GUI agents, GELab-Zero-4B-Preview ( GELab-Team, StepFun, 2025 ) and UI-TARS-1.5-7B ( Qin et al., 2025 ) , on our benchmark. Both models fall into Tier 4, indicating limited transfer from computer-use environments to AAA gameplay. GELab-Zero-4B-Preview achieves 57.1 % 57.1\% overall accuracy and ranks 36th, outperforming UI-TARS-1.5-7B by 4.1 4.1 percentage points. UI-TARS-1.5-7B achieves 53.0 % 53.0\% and ranks 41st, trailing its general-purpose baseline, Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, by 3.7 3.7 percentage points. These results suggest that domain-specific post-training can weaken the model generalization across domains.

blocks.en: Coding Agents. We evaluate three coding agents, including Claude Sonnet 5, Opus 4.8, and Fable 5. Among the three models, Claude Fable 5 performs best, ranking 13th in Tier 2 with 71.2 % 71.2\% overall accuracy. Claude Opus 4.8 and Sonnet 5 fall into Tier 3, ranking 23rd and 24th with 64.8 % 64.8\% and 64.7 % 64.7\% , respectively. Despite the focus on coding abilities, these models generalize well to gameplay and achieve competitive performance on our benchmark. Their advantage over the GUI agents ( Qin et al., 2025 ; GELab-Team, StepFun, 2025 ) may stem from the broader training data, stronger foundation models, and better reasoning capabilities.

blocks.en: Dedicated Game Agents. As shown in Table 7 , the three game agents perform near the 25 % 25\% random baseline on unseen AAA games. Their scores can fall below random because action outputs that fail to match any option are counted as incorrect, e.g. , empty action sequences. JARVIS-VLA ( Li et al., 2025 ) shows strong domain dependence. After fine-tuning on VPT ( Baker et al., 2022 ) , it achieves 54.2 % 54.2\% on the in-domain Minecraft data, comparable to the zero-shot Gemma 4 31B-IT at 54.1 % 54.1\% . However, the accuracy drops to 28.1 % 28.1\% on unseen AAA games. NitroGen ( Magne et al., 2026 ) and Open-P2P ( Yue et al., 2026 ) show similar limitations, as neither is trained on AAA gameplay data with aligned multi-horizon instructions and actions. These results further highlight the value of our dataset covering diverse AAA game titles and multiple temporal horizons.
blocks.zh: 专职游戏代理. 如表7所示,三款游戏代理在未见的AAA游戏上进行接近25%的25QQ随机基线的演出. 他们的分数可以降到随机以下,因为不能匹配任何选项的动作输出被算作不正确,例如空动作序列. JARVIS-VLA(Li等人,2025年)显示出强烈的域依赖性. 在微调VPT(Baker等人,2022年)后,在域内矿工数据上实现了54.2%的54.2\%,与零射入的Gemma 4 31B-IT在54.1%的54.1\%. 然而,在未见的AAA游戏中,精度下降到28.1% 28.1% 。 NitroGen(Magne等人,2026年)和Open-P2P(Yue等人,2026年)表现出类似的局限性,因为两者都没有接受过AAA游戏游戏数据与对齐的多视距指令和行动的培训. 这些结果进一步突出了我们涵盖不同AAA游戏标题和多个时域的数据集的价值.

blocks.en: Effects of Thinking. As shown in Table 10 , thinking does not uniformly improve offline performance. The effects vary with model reasoning quality. Enabling thinking improves the accuracy of GLM-5V-Turbo and Doubao-Seed-2.1-Pro by 5.6 5.6 and 9.3 9.3 percentage points. The gains are particularly pronounced on T 2 T_{2} , reaching 9.0 9.0 and 19.9 19.9 percentage points, suggesting that capable models can leverage thinking to decompose and plan complex goals. In contrast, thinking reduces the accuracy of UI-TARS-1.5-7B and Qwen2.5-VL-7B by 8.2 8.2 and 5.9 5.9 percentage points. Qualitative inspection indicates that lightweight models can produce hallucinated reasoning, thereby misleading action prediction rather than improving it. The results indicate that the efficacy of thinking in gameplay depends on whether it enables models to decompose and plan complex goals correctly. The findings reveal an inherent trade-off between reasoning ability and model efficiency in real-time gameplay.
blocks.zh: 思考的效果。 如表10所示,思维不能统一改善离线性能。 效果随模型推理质量而异. 赋能思维使GLM-5V-Turbo和Doubao-Seed-2.1-Pro的精度提高了5.6和9.39.3个百分点. 在T2 TQQQX2}上,收益特别显著,达到9.0 9.0和19.9 19.9个百分点,这表明有能力的模式能够利用思维来分解和规划复杂的目标. 相比之下,思维将UI-TARS-1.5-7B和Quen2.5-VL-7B的精度降低了8.2和5.95.9个百分点. 定性检查表明轻量级模型可以产生幻觉推理,从而误导动作预测而不是改进. 结果表明,游戏游戏中思维的功效取决于它是否能够使模型分解并正确规划复杂的目标. 调查结果揭示了在实时游戏游戏中推理能力和模型效率之间的内在权衡.

blocks.en: 4.3 Offline Variant Tasks
blocks.zh: 4.3 离线变换任务

blocks.en: Given the evaluation costs, we test four models on 200 200 randomly sampled questions for each of the ten variants.
blocks.zh: 鉴于评估成本,我们测试了四个模型,对200个随机抽样的10个变体中的每个问题进行了200个抽样。

blocks.en: Action Perception and Planning. As shown in Table 11 , all four models consistently perform better on current-action perception than future-action planning across the three input settings. On average, perception outperforms planning by 9.9 9.9 percentage points with frames only, 23.8 23.8 points with short-horizon instructions, and 18.2 18.2 points with multi-horizon instructions. The consistent gap indicates that models more reliably recognize actions depicted in the observed frames than determine appropriate future actions. Future-action planning remains more challenging because it requires inferring subsequent behavior from temporal context. Nevertheless, the capability of planning is essential to gameplay, especially for the complex long-horizon tasks.
blocks.zh: 行动认识和规划。 如表11所示,所有四种模式在目前行动观念方面的表现始终优于三个投入环境的未来行动规划。 平均来说,知觉表现比规划高出9.9个百分点,只有帧,23.823.8个百分点有短视指令,18.218.2个百分点有多视距指令. 始终存在的差距表明,模型比确定适当的未来行动更可靠地确认所观察到的框架中所描述的行动。 未来行动规划仍然更具挑战性,因为它要求从时间背景推断随后的行为。 尽管如此,规划能力对于游戏游戏至关重要,对于复杂的长视野任务尤其如此.

blocks.en: Visual Inputs and Textual Instructions. Table 11 shows that adding short-horizon instructions to the visual inputs consistently improves action perception across all four models. Average accuracy increases by 14.1 14.1 percentage points, from 44.5 % 44.5\% with frames only to 58.6 % 58.6\% with short-horizon instructions. Notably, the improvement is achieved solely by adding the instructions to the model inputs, without any fine-tuning on our annotations. The results indicate that visual observations alone ( Magne et al., 2026 ) may not fully specify task intent, whereas textual instructions can help models to identify the correct operations for the specified game goals. The finding underscores the value of our instructions as inputs for model training and evaluation in gameplay.
blocks.zh: 视觉输入和文字指导. 表11显示,在视觉投入中增加短视指示,持续改善所有四个模型的行动感知。 平均精度提高14.1 14.1个百分点,从只有帧的44.5% 44.5%提高到58.6% 58.6%,有短视指示. 值得注意的是,仅通过在模型投入中增加说明,而不对我们的说明作任何微调,就实现了改进。 结果显示,光是视觉观察(Magne et al., 2026)可能不能完全指定任务意图,而文字指示可以帮助模型识别特定游戏目标的正确操作. 调查结果强调了我们的指示作为游戏模式培训和评价投入的价值。

Multi-Horizon Pyramid. In Table 11 , instruction horizons have distinct effects on current-action perception and future-action planning. For action perception, short-horizon instructions increase average accuracy by 14.1 14.1 points, whereas multi-horizon instructions yield only a further 1.4 1.4 -point improvement to 60.0 % 60.0\% . Conversely, for future planning, short-horizon instructions produce only a 0.2 0.2 -point improvement, while multi-horizon instructions further increase accuracy from 34.8 % 34.8\% to 41.8 % 41.8\% by 7.0 7.0 points. Short-horizon instructions directly describe immediate operations and therefore align more closely with current actions. Medium- and long-horizon instructions provide sustained goals and game strategies that better guide future planning. These results demonstrate the advantage of our multi-horizon pyramid over the prior simple instructions ( Yue et al., 2026 ) . Overall, our multi-horizon framework can support both immediate decision-making and future-task planning.
blocks.zh: 多胡同金字塔. 在表11中,指导视野对当前行动观念和未来行动规划有明显的影响。 对于动作感知,短视指令将平均精度提高14.1 14.1分,而多视距指令仅产生1.4 1.4 - 点提高至60.0% 60.0% 。 反之,对于未来的规划,短视指令只产生0.2 0.2-点的改进,而多视距指令的准确度则进一步从34.8% 34.8\%提高到41.8% 41.8\%,提高了7.0 7.0分. 短视指示直接描述了即时行动,因此与当前行动更加一致. 中长期指示提供持续的目标和游戏战略,更好地指导未来的规划。 这些结果显示,我们的多视距金字塔比先前的简单指示(Yue等人,2026年)有优势。 总体而言,我们的多视野框架可以支持立即决策和未来任务规划。

blocks.en: Top-Down and Bottom-Up. In Table 14 \subref tab:t2_variant, all four models perform substantially better on bottom-up abstraction than top-down decomposition. Average accuracy reaches 98.4 % 98.4\% for abstraction but only 69.5 % 69.5\% for decomposition, with a gap of 28.9 28.9 percentage points. For bottom-up abstraction, concrete low-level action sequences contain sufficient information to identify the corresponding higher-level goals, resulting in near-ceiling accuracy. Although this saturation limits its discriminability for evaluation, the reliable bottom-up mapping is well suited to our annotation pipeline, which constructs higher-level instructions from segmented short-horizon trajectories. In contrast, top-down decomposition starts from abstract goals and strategies that omit operational details and may correspond to multiple valid action sequences. The information insufficiency and underdetermination make top-down decomposition unsuitable for annotation but turn it into a challenging evaluation task for goal decomposition and planning. Together, these results justify our complementary design choices, i.e. , the bottom-up abstraction for data annotation and top-down decomposition for model evaluation.
blocks.zh: Top- Down and Bottom- Up. 在表14\subref tab:t2_variant中,所有四个模型在自下而上的抽象上的表现都大大优于自上而下的分解. 抽象化的平均精度达到98.4% 98.4\%,而分解的精度只有69.5% 69.5\%,差距为28.9 28.9个百分点. 对于自下而上的抽象,具体的低级动作序列中包含足够的信息来识别相应的更高层次的目标,从而产生近乎最高的准确性. 虽然这种饱和性限制了它对于评价的区别性,但可靠的自下而上的绘图非常适合我们的注解管道,它构建了从片段短视轨迹中得出的更高层次的指示. 与此相反,自上而下分解是从抽象的目标和策略开始的,这些目标和策略省略了操作细节,可能与多个有效的动作序列对应. 信息不足和确定性不足,使得自上而下分解不适于作注释,但变成了目标分解和规划的具有挑战性的评价任务。 这些结果共同证明我们可以作出互补的设计选择,即自下而上抽象的数据注释和自上而下分解模型评价。

blocks.en: Action-Decoding Error. In Table 14 \subref tab:t3_variant, adding action sequences to the cross-horizon consistency task causes only modest performance degradation. Average accuracy decreases from 74.0 % 74.0\% without actions to 73.4 % 73.4\% with actions, corresponding to a loss of 0.6 0.6 percentage points. The limited gap indicates that decoding low-level action sequences introduces little additional error beyond matching instructions across temporal horizons. Most errors therefore arise from decomposing, planning, and aligning multi-horizon goals rather than from action decoding. The results help to locate the primary bottleneck for current models in gameplay scenarios.
blocks.zh: 动作解析错误 。 在表14\subref tab:t3_variant中,在跨视距一致性任务中添加动作序列只会造成适度性能退化. 平均精度从74.0%74.0\%无动作下降到73.4%73.4\%有动作,相当于损失0.6个百分点. 有限的缺口表明,对低级动作序列进行解码,除了在时间范围内匹配指令之外,引入了很少额外的错误. 因此,大多数错误产生于多领域目标的分解、规划和调整,而不是行动解码。 其结果有助于在游戏情景中找到当前模型的主要瓶颈。

blocks.en: 4.4 Stepwise Online Track
blocks.zh: 4.4 逐步在线轨道

blocks.en: Offline–Online Association. In Table 15 , online performance closely aligns with offline rankings. Models from offline Tiers 1–4 occupy online ranks 1–3, 4–6, 7–9, and 10–12, respectively. The positive association proves that our offline track captures relevant abilities and provides an effective indicator of online gameplay performance.
blocks.zh: 下线–在线协会. 在表15中,在线性能与离线排名紧密一致. 离线1至4级的模型分别占据1至3、4至6、7至9和10至12位。 积极的关联证明我们的离线轨道能捕捉到相关能力,为在线游戏游戏表现提供了有效的指标.

blocks.en: Long-Horizon Challenges. The long-horizon online tasks remain difficult for current models. GPT-6-Astra achieves the highest success rate of 45.0 % 45.0\% , while ten of the twelve models achieve at most 10.0 % 10.0\% . Each long-horizon task requires many sequential operations. A single failure in a short-horizon subtask can invalidate the entire task. The results expose existing limitations in long-horizon game planning and strategy formulation.
blocks.zh: 长征挑战. 对目前的模型来说,长视线在线任务仍然很困难。 GPT-6-Astra取得最高成功率为45.0% 45.0%,而12种模式中的10种最多达到10.0% 10.0%。 每项远视任务都需要许多顺序行动. 短视子任务中的一次失败可以使整个任务失效. 结果暴露了长期游戏规划和战略制定方面的现有局限性。

blocks.en: Stepwise Diagnosis. As described in Fig. 5 and Sec. 3.4 , each long-horizon causal or thematic task is decomposed into short-horizon subtasks. The stepwise protocol with game resets can localize failures to specific operations. E.g. , we can distinguish models that do not know how to craft a cake from those that understand the procedure but perform a certain step incorrectly. This design can support fine-grained diagnosis in long-horizon gameplay.
blocks.zh: 相继诊断. 如图5和图3.4所述,每个长视因果或专题任务都分解成短视子任务。 带有游戏重置的阶梯协议可以将失败定位到特定操作中. 例如,我们可以区分那些不知道如何制作蛋糕的模型和那些理解程序但错误地执行某种步骤的模型. 这种设计可以在长视游戏游戏中支持精细的诊断.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We propose GameHorizon, a unified data and evaluation suite that measures gameplay capabilities at different horizons across diverse model families. First, GameHorizon-Annotator can automatically build a dense instruction pyramid spanning short-horizon operations, medium-horizon goals, and long-horizon strategies. Second, we construct GameHorizon-Data, a large-scale AAA gameplay dataset with temporally aligned videos, actions, and multi-horizon instructions in 21 21 titles. Third, based on our data, GameHorizon-Bench combines reproducible offline evaluation with stepwise online testing, enabling standardized model comparisons and fine-grained failure diagnosis. Extensive experiments reveal capability differences among current models and identify their primary bottlenecks. Our work can serve as a data foundation and unified yardstick for systematically examining the gameplay performance across model families and temporal horizons.
blocks.zh: 我们提出GameHorizon, 一个统一的数据和评价套件, 在不同模式家庭的不同视野下测量游戏能力。 首先,GameHorizon-Annotator可以自动构建一个密集的教学金字塔,跨越短视操作,中视目标,以及长视战略. 其次,我们构建了GameHorizon-Data,这是一个大型的AAA游戏机数据集,在21个标题中包含时间对齐的视频,动作,以及多视距指令. 第三,基于我们的数据,GameHorizon-Bench将可复制的离线评价与逐步在线测试相结合,使得标准化模型比较和精细的故障诊断成为可能。 广泛的实验揭示了现有模型之间的能力差异,并确定了它们的主要瓶颈。 我们的工作可以作为一个数据基础和统一的尺度,系统地审查模范家庭和时间范围之间的游戏表演。

blocks.en: A.1 Annotation Prompts

blocks.en: As described in Sec. 3.2 of the main paper, we utilize a VLM to annotate the multi-horizon instructions. Here, we present the annotation prompts for short-horizon operations, medium-horizon goals, and long-horizon strategies in Fig. 6 , Fig. 7 , and Fig. 8 , respectively. The short-horizon prompt takes sampled frames and temporally aligned keyboard-mouse actions as inputs. It requires the VLM to describe the current operation with sufficient critical details, such as object descriptions and spatial relations. The medium-horizon prompt also incorporates the constituent short-horizon instructions and asks the VLM to summarize the player’s goal while avoiding excessive local details. Game-specific keybinds are additionally provided in the short- and medium-horizon prompts to help the VLM interpret keyboard and mouse actions in terms of their in-game semantics. The long-horizon prompt takes sampled frames and the constituent medium-horizon goals as inputs while omitting actions and keybinds. It requires the VLM to capture the player’s overall gameplay strategy without local operational details. Across all three horizons, the prompts provide common video metadata, including the game type, clip duration, frame rate, and sampled frame indices. They also require the VLM to analyze the visual context and output only a natural-language instruction without any additional explanation.

blocks.en: A.2 Action-Aware Video Segmentation
blocks.zh: A.2 预告视频片段

blocks.en: We provide more details on the action-aware video segmentation. The segmentation follows four stages, including keyboard-mouse semantic calibration, primitive action classification, rule-based coarse segmentation, and VLM-based refinement. First, using game-specific keybinds, we map raw keyboard and mouse events to gameplay actions, such as movement, attack, interaction, skill activation, and menu operations. When one input can correspond to multiple actions, we retain all candidates instead of making an early decision. Second, we classify primitive actions as input-deterministic, input-ambiguous, or vision-dependent according to how reliably their semantics can be inferred from the inputs. Third, we replay the frame-aligned input logs to recover held keys, discrete triggers, mouse-button states, and camera movements. When multiple actions occur in the same frame, action-priority rules select the primary label, while the remaining actions are retained as concurrent evidence. Consecutive frames with identical labels are merged, short noisy segments are smoothed, and overly long segments are divided. Finally, ambiguous or vision-dependent segments are refined by a VLM using videos, candidate labels, action semantics, and trigger timestamps. We further remove temporal gaps and overlaps, producing segments with continuous action events. Our GameHorizon-Annotator is also compatible with segmentation tools such as PySceneDetect [ Castellano, 2024 ] , which detects boundaries based on inter-frame visual similarity and can therefore fragment continuous actions under large camera movements.
blocks.zh: 我们提供了更多关于行动意识视频分割的细节。 分化分为四个阶段,包括键盘-mouse语义校准,原始动作分类,基于规则的粗分化,以及基于VLM的精细化. 首先,使用特定游戏键盘,我们将原始键盘和鼠标事件映射到游戏游戏动作,如移动,攻击,互动,技能激活,以及菜单操作. 当一种投入能够对应多种行动时,我们保留所有候选人,而不是及早作出决定。 第二,我们根据其语义如何可靠地从输入中推断出来,将原始行动归类为输入决定性、输入矛盾性或视觉依赖性。 第三,我们重放帧对齐的输入日志以恢复持有的密钥,离散的触发器,鼠标按钮状态,以及相机运动. 当在同一框架中发生多个行动时,优先行动规则会选择主标签,而其余行动则保留作为并行证据。 具有相同标签的连续框被合并,短吵的片段被平滑,过度长的片段被分割. 最后,一个VLM利用视频、候选标签、动作语义和触发时间戳来改进模棱两可或依赖视觉的部分。 我们进一步消除时间上的空白和重叠,产生有持续行动活动的部分。 我们的GameHorizon-Annotator也与PyScene Detect [Castellano, 2024]等分解工具兼容,这些分解工具根据帧间视觉相似性探测边界,因此可以在大型相机运动下分解连续动作.
